---
title: "Albums"
resources:
  - data
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
albumsData = FileAttachment("data/similarity.json").json()

artists = ["All", ...new Set(albumsData.map(d => d.artist).sort())]

viewof selectedArtist = Inputs.select(artists, { label: "Select an artist:" })

filteredAlbums = selectedArtist === "All" 
  ? albumsData 
  : albumsData.filter(d => d.artist === selectedArtist)

viewof album = Inputs.select(
  new Map(filteredAlbums.map(d => [selectedArtist === "All" ? d.display : d.title, d.file])),
  { label: "Select an album:" }
)

html`<div style="margin-top: 20px;">
  <img src="${album}" alt="Album cover" style="max-width: 400px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
</div>`

currentAlbum = albumsData.find(d => d.file === album)

similarAlbums = currentAlbum?.similar.slice(0, 3) ?? []

differentAlbums = currentAlbum ? currentAlbum.similar.slice(-3).reverse() : []

html`
<div style="margin-top: 30px;">
  <h3>Most Similar Albums</h3>
  <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
    ${similarAlbums.map(d => html`
      <div style="text-align: center; width: 160px;">
        <img src="${d.file}" alt="${d.display}" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
        <p style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px;">${d.display}</p>
      </div>
    `)}
  </div>
</div>

<div style="margin-top: 30px;">
  <h3>Most Different Albums</h3>
  <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
    ${differentAlbums.map(d => html`
      <div style="text-align: center; width: 160px;">
        <img src="${d.file}" alt="${d.display}" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
        <p style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px;">${d.display}</p>
      </div>
    `)}
  </div>
</div>
`
```
